purpose: Exploratory external foreground/background-memory comparator, not a SAM2 region ablation
input_masks: Existing frame-wise MedSAM2 YOLO predictions, never ground truth

arms.initial_only: First nonempty detected prediction initializes the object; native Cutie thereafter
arms.detector_refresh: Same initialization; every subsequent available detector prediction is a correction, including empty predicted masks

readout: Unmodified author foreground/background object transformer and memory manager
settings: Author eval_config d17-val defaults and scripting_demo max_internal_size=480; no tuning on these videos
medsam2_detector_refresh_control: Native box inference without a memory read on detected frames, normal memory encoding/write and default-bank propagation on missing-detection frames; no readout weights or quality rule
limitations: Author defaults include top-k retrieval and a memory-update schedule; not an assumption-free method
Different backbone from SAM2 and different prompt budgets between arms
Cutie receives cached masks and MedSAM2 receives the same underlying boxes; prompt semantics and internal resizing are not identical
Supplied Cutie correction masks are resized by the author processor; gains on correction frames are not evidence of a learned memory-readout benefit
Previously inspected development sequences; not held-out confirmation
Cutie has foreground/background attention but does not establish special boundary-token utility
Public pretraining data overlap has not been independently audited
MemSAM is cloned for source inspection only; its reinforcement module is not integrated or evaluated
